minutes.summary: The Parks Commission heard a beach season review, a Little League report on fields and registrations, and skate park and septic updates for Marshall Park. It voted on field use dates, rescinded the earlier skate park size limit, and approved changed RFP dates for the Marshall Park master plan.

votes.motion: Abide by the November 30 date on the signed field form for this season's fall use, extended to cover porta potty and dumpster.
Rescind the previous vote limiting the Marshall Park skate park size to 5,000 square feet.
Accept the changed RFP dates (decision November 22, public meetings Dec 2, Dec 20, week of Jan 5) and add a May 1 completion date.

what_happened.line: The Parks Commission voted to rescind its earlier limit on the size of the Marshall Park skate park.
The commission accepted changed dates for the Marshall Park master plan RFP and added a May 1 completion date.
The commission voted to keep the signed November 30 field form date for fall use, extended to cover the porta potty and dumpster.
Interviews for the master plan RFP are set for the November 17 meeting, with the award decision on November 22.
Members will attend a Board of Health meeting on November 1 about the Marshall Park septic design flow.

why_it_matters: With the size limit rescinded, the skate park can be planned larger than before, and the committee said the final size may be trimmed to match the money raised, so the cost to the town budget is not yet settled.
The Marshall Park master plan RFP timeline and the septic design review set what gets designed and permitted for a town park, with public meetings planned for December and January.
watch_next: November 22 meeting: conceptual skate park plans at sizes above the old limit, and the master plan RFP award decision.
November 1 Board of Health meeting on the Marshall Park septic design flow.
